newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak shares weaken, SAX down 6.01 pts at 215.27.
newsitem.headline: Slovak shares weaken, SAX down 6.01 pts at 215.27.

text.p: Slovak shares closed weaker in quiet trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday, pushing the 12-share SAX index down 6.01 points to 215.27.
"It was a quiet day with no big trades either on or off the floor and that pushed the index down," ING Bank dealer Libor Chrast said.
"The market reflected what I expect to be a general trend of consolidation after a long bullish period," Chrast added.
Oil refiner Slovnaft, the most heavily weighted issue of the index shed 47 crowns to close at 950, while steelmaker VSZ lost 10 to close at 950.
Investment fund VUB Kupon recovered 23 crowns from a mid-session low, but still closed 10 down at 725.
Overall volume rose to 347,526 shares traded on Tuesday from 103,258 shares on Monday, as turnover grew to 282.68 million crowns from 154.12 million, both as a result of direct trades.
